label: live
test: Projects and a manual planned change render the full plan, stream, Why and verified Changes
expected: the Jevellan web app "conversation" screen at phone-dark, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "Projects and a manual planned change render the full plan, stream, Why and verified Changes"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The 'Proposed plan' / 'The full fixture plan' headings are much larger than the other text on the screen, so the card's type hierarchy feels heavy on a narrow phone.
The 'Step details' disclosure rows and the 'Local time' labels are dim grey on the dark background and are fairly low-contrast.
Two closure banners appear one after the other ('Work closed. Its changes are kept…' and 'Work closed and published.'), which looks redundant.

The plan lists three steps, but only Step 1 (Plan) and Step 2 (Implement) are shown as step blocks; there is no separate verify/publish step block, although the closing banner says the work was published.

In Step 2 the tool output still says 'The fixture starts with value 1.' right before the line saying the value is now 2. This is correct for a read done before the change, but it can look contradictory at a glance.
